name: octolock
flavor_text: The user locks the target in and prevents it from fleeing. This move also lowers the target’s Defense and Sp. Def every turn.
effect_text_extend: Prevents the target from switching out. At the end of each turn, the targets Defense and Special Defense are lowered by 1 stage. The target may switch out using a Shed shell, Baton Pass, Flip turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-Turn, or Volt Switch. This effect ends if either Pokemon leave the field.
effect_text_simple: Prevents the target from switching out. At the end of each turn, the targets Defense and Special Defense are lowered by 1 stage.
